name: smart-study-scheduler
description: AI-Based Smart Study Scheduler and Task Optimizer

scripts.dev: npm run build -w frontend && npm run dev -w backend
scripts.build: npm run build -w frontend && npm run build -w backend
scripts.start: node -e "if(!require('fs').existsSync('frontend/dist/index.html')||!require('fs').existsSync('backend/dist/server.js'))require('child_process').execSync('npm run build',{stdio:'inherit'})" && npm run start -w backend
